_readme: THE PERSONAL-PROFILE SOURCE of rajasekarselvam.com. Every personal fact any page of this site prints is rendered from this file by tooling/sites/generate-personal-site.mjs, and its --check refuses a page that types one of these values outside a generated region. Company facts are NOT here: Nikatru's are read from tooling/house-identity.json.
These are the owner's own facts, supplied 2026-10-02. Add nothing the owner has not given; change a value here and re-run the generator, never on a page.
Served as a static file under the deploy root like everything else in it: it holds only what the pages already print.
